  --source-commit "$GITHUB_SHA" --client-version "$client_version" \

steps.name: Free disposable runner disk for installation
Prepare protected Google Drive configuration
Mount complete streamed ISO with ImDisk proxy
Fetch private smoke-test runtime
steps.run:
$assets = "$env:PRIVATE_ROOT\assets"
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $assets | Out-Null
rclone --config $env:RCLONE_CONFIG_FILE copy "gdrive:$env:SW_ASSETS_PATH" $assets `
  --include "/SolidWorks_Flexnet_Server/**" `
  --include "/SOLIDWORKS Corp/SOLIDWORKS/**" `
  --include "/sw2025_network_serials_licensing.reg" `
  --exclude "*" `
  --transfers 4 `
  --checkers 8 `
  --log-level NOTICE
foreach ($required in @(
  "$assets\sw2025_network_serials_licensing.reg",
  "$assets\SolidWorks_Flexnet_Server",
  "$assets\SOLIDWORKS Corp\SOLIDWORKS"
)) {
  if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $required)) { throw "Missing private test input: $required" }
}

steps.name: Apply private runtime overlay and start test license service
Install built SWCLI wheel
Prepare property fixtures for public CLI verification
steps.run:

  --output-dir "$env:SWCLI_SMOKE_ROOT\properties-calibration" `
  --swconst "C:\Program Files\SOLIDWORKS\swconst.tlb"
if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "Property fixture preparation failed; see original report/trace" }

steps.name: Prepare annotation fixtures for public CLI verification
steps.run:

  --output-dir "$env:SWCLI_SMOKE_ROOT\annotation-fixtures" `
  --swconst "C:\Program Files\SOLIDWORKS\swconst.tlb" `
  --drawing-template $drawingTemplate
if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "Annotation fixture preparation failed; see original report/trace" }

steps.name: Run real SOLIDWORKS modeling and export smoke test
